items.title: Linux home
items.summary: Tells the assistant where this chat's folder is, and not to guess when you skip a question. Already in Jasiri.

items.title: Write an automation
items.summary: Instructions for saving a task the chat can run on a schedule. Already in Jasiri.

items.title: Find anything by describing it
items.summary: Search photos, videos, and documents on your phone in plain language, like “the receipt from the plumber in March”. Not in the app yet. Today you can attach one photo in a chat, when the model can see images.

items.title: Media tagger and organizer
items.summary: Sort photos and recordings by project or course, then search them. Not in the app yet. Files you save in a chat folder stay in that folder.

items.title: AI-aware file manager
items.summary: A file manager the assistant can work with, while you stay in control. Not in the app yet. The assistant can already read and write files in the chat's folder.

items.title: Notes and to-dos, Obsidian compatible
items.summary: Plain Markdown notes that follow you from one device to another. Not in the app yet. Each chat already has a folder of files on this phone.

items.title: Video transcoder
items.summary: Shrink a large video and keep it watchable. Not in the app yet.

items.title: Backups
items.summary: Copy the folders you choose to a place you choose, on a schedule. Not in the app yet. You can already copy a chat's folder out yourself.

items.title: Learning labs
items.summary: Programming, Linux, and networking practice, installed from one button. Not in the app yet. You can already practice on the Linux system, from the assistant or the terminal.

items.title: Local AI models
items.summary: Run a smaller model on the phone for a job that does not need a large one. Not in the app yet. Today the assistant uses the provider you choose.
